claim_lines.notes: Attachment is Gracia 'Sales Performance by Supplier' report (salper_sp.rep), supplier 21550 PT Filia Sukses Mandiri, not a debit note; doc no. is the large stamped number. Store range (aggregated, no per-store split): 2 - MARKET CITY PIK to 8 - MARKET CITY SANUR BL. Rows = Olaif SKUs whose 'Discount (Excl.VAT)' cell is highlighted/ticked; dpp/total = that discount, rounded to integer (exact 2-decimal values: 12533181=2450.45, 12533289=116441.44, 12533109=186729.73, 12584359=88488.29, 12533225=16662.16, 12533234=50887.39, 13533330=45099.10, 13581529=136310.81, 14533481=42567.57, 14533561=11621.62, 14533454=25648.65). qty = total Qty Sales of the SKU in the period (not necessarily promo qty). No PPN added; report's discount column is excl. VAT and Filia invoices it without VAT. Implied disc rates (derived, not printed): 12533181: disc 2450.45 / sales 24504.50 = 10.00%; 12533289: disc 116441.44 / sales 1164414.42 = 10.00%; 12533109: disc 186729.73 / sales 1867297.30 = 10.00%; 12584359: disc 88488.29 / sales 589954.96 = 15.00%; 12533225: disc 16662.16 / sales 166621.62 = 10.00%; 12533234: disc 50887.39 / sales 508873.87 = 10.00%; 13533330: disc 45099.10 / sales 450990.99 = 10.00%; 13581529: disc 136310.81 / sales 908738.74 = 15.00%; 14533481: disc 42567.57 / sales 425675.67 = 10.00%; 14533561: disc 11621.62 / sales 116216.22 = 10.00%; 14533454: disc 25648.65 / sales 256486.49 = 10.00%. YEAR CHECK: the attachment really says 2025 (Period Sales 01-MAR-25 - 30-MAR-25, printed 24-SEP-25), so Filia's '2025' label is correct - this is an old (17-month) claim billed in Aug 2026. Report is 'Page x to 7'; only pages 2,4,5,6 are attached - pages 1, 3 and 7 are missing. Page 3 would hold the rest of Dept 12 (hair care / hand & body); per the printed totals there is 5,960.77 (excl VAT) of Class 4 discount and ~144,841 of Dept 12 discount on that missing page, so it cannot be confirmed whether any Olaif discount there was left out. EXCLUDED: 12533118 OLAIF ANTISEPTIC WET WIPES discount 495.99 (highlighted, not ticked; digits blurry, value inferred = subclass total 187,225.72 - 186,729.73). Filia's 722,907 matches exactly (722,907.21) only with that line excluded, so Laif may be under-billed by ~496 if it was a valid promo line. BIYU 12589096 discount 1,315.32 is bracketed with the Olaif line but is not Olaif and was not claimed. Subclass/class/dept totals cross-checked: Dept 13 383,675 and Dept 14 88,620 (dept totals are printed incl VAT, = ex-VAT x 1.11) match the claimed lines exactly.
